parts:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for the feedback.

I've extended experi() to handle ada, and that is now updated on http://onepager.togaware.com/ (Models).

However I can't seem to repeat the problem you are having - perhaps try the following and see if you get the error - also note that control with rpart.control does not yet work.

library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(ada)

weather <- read.csv("http://rattle.togaware.com/weather.csv")
ds      <- weather
target  <- "RainTomorrow"
vars    <- colnames(ds)
risk    <- "RISK_MM"
ignore  <- vars[c(1, 2, ifelse(exists("risk"), which(risk==vars), NULL))]
vars    <- setdiff(vars, ignore)
form    <- formula(paste(target, "~ ."))

source("http://onepager.togaware.com/experi.R")

ex.rp <- experi(form, ds[vars], target, "rpart", "1", n=10,
                keep.pr=TRUE)

ex.rf <- experi(form, ds[vars], target, "randomForest", "500", n=10,
                control=list(na.action=na.omit), keep.pr=TRUE)

ex.ad <- experi(form, ds[vars], target, "ada", "50", n=10,
                keep.pr=TRUE)

(results <- rbind(ex.rp, ex.rf, ex.ad))


Regards,
Graham

parts:
Thanks Tom.

I could not get the same error you did, but did get different errors:

1) The target is numeric so without knowing experi() just does a regression rather than a classification.

2) The dataset is small and experi does rather trivial sampling, so it can generate a test dataset with no cases in it. Experi() now checks for that.

With current version of experi(), the following works:

library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(ada)

sample <- read.csv("sample.csv")

ds      <- sample
target  <-"WashOutIND"
vars    <- colnames(ds)
risk    <- "Null"
ignore  <- vars[c(1, 2, ifelse(exists("risk"), which(risk==vars), NULL))]
vars    <- setdiff(vars, ignore)
ds[[target]] <- as.factor(ds[[target]])

form    <- formula(paste(target, "~ ."))
source("http://onepager.togaware.com/experi.R")
ex.rp <- experi(form,ds[vars], target, "rpart", "1", n=10,
                keep.pr=TRUE)
 
#ex.rf <- experi(form, ds[vars], target, "randomForest", "500", n=10,
 #               control=list(na.action=na.omit), keep.pr=TRUE)

ex.ad <- experi(form, ds[vars], target, "ada", "50", n=10,
                 keep.pr=TRUE)

(results <- rbind(ex.rp, ex.ad))
 

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
